Package com.rpglab.game.interfaces

Interface Scene

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    CombatScene
    public interface Scene
    Represents a scene or location within the Dungeon Adventure RPG world. Scenes are discrete areas that heroes can visit, each with specific characteristics, events, and completion conditions.

    Scenes may contain combat encounters, story events, environmental hazards, or other interactive elements that affect the hero's journey through the game world.

    Since:

    • Method Detail

      • Start

        void Start​(Hero hero)
        Initiates this scene with the specified hero. This method begins the scene's events, interactions, and effects that the hero will experience.
        Parameters:
        hero - The hero entering or starting this scene

      • isCompleted

        boolean isCompleted()
        Checks whether this scene has been completed. Completion conditions vary by scene type and may include defeating enemies, solving puzzles, or reaching specific objectives.
        Returns:
        true if the scene is completed, false otherwise

      • getSceneType

        SceneType getSceneType()
        Returns the type of this scene. The scene type determines the specific characteristics, effects, and behaviors associated with this scene.
        Returns:
        The SceneType enum value representing this scene's type
